_about: The Library's books. Each guide's text is the Discord posts in data/src/kb/<file>, split by <<<POST>>> lines. Tags after bold or italic text colour it on the site and are stripped from the Discord copy: {q} quest, {n} friendly NPC, {h} hostile, {i} item. 'at' is when the book went on the shelf (it gets a ! until you've seen it).

guides.title: Ultimate BRD Quest Guide
guides.blurb: The Alliance BRD quests in two runs, with one trip back to Ironforge in between. First written for Turtle WoW, then checked against Forever.
unsure: BRD wasn't in the Forever beta, so this leans on Forever's quest data and Blizzard's hotfixes more than on anyone's run.
Nobody has confirmed the Frenzied Black Drake still turns up at Cyrus. If it doesn't, do the Searing Gorge chain.
The Spectral Chalice needed Mining 230 in Classic. Forever's quest page doesn't say.
Attunement to the Core is in Forever's quest data, but Molten Core isn't open yet. If Lothos doesn't offer it, it isn't switched on.
